profile: Bangladeshi MBBS (2019–20 session), results out September 2026, internship from Oct–Nov 2026 in Chattogram, no work experience, USD 30k budget. Long-term goal: practise medicine in the US. Fields: public health, epidemiology, global health, clinical research, aerospace medicine.

truths.title: Finish the internship
truths.body: Without it there is no full BMDC registration, so no FCPS, full GMC, Saudi, Qatar or UAE licence, and no AHPRA registration. Realistic time to leave: December 2027 to April 2028.

truths.title: Best bridge to the US
truths.body: Take Step 1 during the internship, then a paid US research job, then Step 2 CK, aiming for the 2029 Match. That keeps the graduation recent (about 3 years) and earns US letters of recommendation.

truths.title: Apply now, start later
truths.body: Erasmus Mundus, Gates Cambridge, KAUST, MEXT, GKS, Stipendium Hungaricum, Türkiye and CSC need no work experience. Most 2027 starts collide with the internship, so ask each programme about late arrival or aim for 2028.

journey.title: The application wave
journey.body: Funded master's and PhD deadlines cluster here. One master motivation letter, adapted per programme.

journey.title: Internship year
journey.body: Unlocks full BMDC registration — the key to every licence route.

journey.title: USMLE Step 1
journey.body: Sit it during the internship. Decide on PLAB 1 before Dhaka sittings end in Feb 2027.

journey.title: Departure window
journey.body: Internship done. Start a funded degree, or a paid research post abroad.

journey.title: US research job + Step 2 CK
journey.body: J-1 Research Scholar or H-1B cap-exempt post. US letters. ECFMG Pathway + OET.

journey.title: The Match
journey.body: Graduation still recent, US experience in hand.

checklist: Imperial President's PhD: round 1 closed 2 Nov. Aim for round 2 (11 Jan 2027) only if a supervisor has agreed to back you.
Start a WES course-by-course evaluation ($239, about 4–6 weeks). US applications are incomplete without it.
Ask referees now — two letters minimum, up to five helps for the US route. Referees are the slowest part.
Write one master motivation letter, then tailor a copy per programme. Make a Europass CV for Erasmus Mundus and DAAD.
Ask the medical college when the MBBS degree certificate is issued, and book IELTS (target 7.0) so scores land before the Dec–Jan deadlines.
PLAB 1 ends in Dhaka from Feb 2027 — decide now whether to book a Dhaka sitting, or plan to sit in India or the UK later.
November deadlines: OIST 15 Nov (23:59 JST), Sanger 24 Nov (09:00 GMT), ETH ESOP 30 Nov, Yenching 30 Nov (09:00 Beijing).

1 December group: Johns Hopkins (Epidemiology, and Global Disease Epidemiology and Control: GRE needed) , Emory, Yale and Pittsburgh PhDs; Hong Kong PhD Fellowship (noon HKT); A*STAR SINGA; Max Planck Schools; Neurasmus; Eu-HEM; Oxford MSc GHSE; Groningen Master's application (for the Bleumink nomination); UIC and Brown MPH priority dates.
Erasmus Mundus windows opening: HYGIEIA 16 Nov, LIVE_Innov 18 Nov, IDOH 1 Dec. NOHA closes 15 Dec, 23:59 GMT.
December: Commonwealth Shared 8 Dec, Gates Cambridge 8 Dec or 6 Jan (by course), Maastricht file 10 Dec, Sydney RTP 18 Dec, PHID and NTU 31 Dec.
51st BCS: if applied, watch bpsc.gov.bd for the MCQ date and admit card; keep the temporary BMDC registration and exam-dates certificate ready.
Italy: start collecting family income and asset documents now — they decide the DSU grant and take the longest.

Mon 9 Nov: email the MRC supervisors of your two chosen projects (project title in the subject) and, in the same sitting, fbmh.doctoralacademy.admissions@manchester.ac.uk to ask whether an MBBS with the internship in progress meets the degree rule, whether an English-medium MBBS waives the offer-stage test, and the application fee.

Mon 9 Nov: email BSPH.EpiAcademic@jh.edu - does the internship year satisfy the one-year work-experience line (programme page says required, FAQ says strongly recommended), and can the WES evaluation follow after submission?

Mon 9 Nov: tell all referees both sets of dates (MRC 27 Nov; Hopkins, Emory, Pittsburgh, Yale 1 Dec) and get institutional email addresses for the MRC two-referee request; ask for the third Hopkins letter explicitly.

Tue 10 Nov: open SOPHAS, LaneyConnect, the Pittsburgh portal and the Yale GSAS application; call SOPHAS on 617-612-2090 to check the international fee-waiver fund, and request the waiver by Wed 11 Nov (processing takes up to 10 business days, then a 14-day clock); if not approved by Fri 20 Nov, pay the $155.

Tue 10 Nov: settle the English test - Hopkins needs TOEFL iBT 5.0 on the new scale (100 only for pre-21 Jan 2026 scores) or IELTS 7; Pittsburgh 100/5 new, IELTS 7.0; Yale PhD asks Speaking minimums only; MRC needs no test until an offer.
Fri 13 Nov: pick the 2 Emory Epidemiology faculty you will name and draft the Emory 500-word statement and the 500-word collaborative-communities statement.

Sun 15 Nov: first drafts done - Hopkins statement (two-page limit), Yale statement (up to 3 faculty), Pittsburgh personal statement (research description first), MRC supporting statement per project (2-4 pages recommended).
Tue 17 Nov: chase MRC supervisors who have not replied; Thu 19 Nov: commit to your final two projects.

Fri 20 Nov: chase referees who have not uploaded; decide whether to add Columbia (preferred 1 Dec), Brown (priority 1 Dec, verified by 15 Dec) and UIC (priority 1 Dec, $80 supplement) MPH to the SOPHAS file; Sun 22 Nov: activate the backup referee if needed and submit Emory.
Wed 25 Nov: submit Hopkins on SOPHAS and both MRC applications; do not wait for deadline day.
Fri 27 Nov: submit Pittsburgh and Yale; MRC deadline day is already covered by 25 Nov.
Mon 30 Nov: sweep all portals; confirm the third Hopkins letter is received, not only requested; Hopkins supporting documents are due within two weeks after 1 Dec.

This week: check whether you can sit the GRE before 1 Dec (Hopkins Global Disease Epidemiology and Control requires it); if no seat or score in time, skip that programme and keep Hopkins Epidemiology, which does not review GRE.
documents: Or, during internship, a provisional certificate or letter stating expected completion.
Every professional exam, plus a WES evaluation for the US.
The format Erasmus Mundus and DAAD expect.
One master version plus tailored copies.
Two minimum; up to five strong ones for the US.
IELTS/TOEFL, or a Medium-of-Instruction certificate where accepted.
Dated within 12 months — a utility bill or bank statement.
Italy DSU only: legalised, translated, converted to an ISEE parificato.
Papers and manuscripts — what makes direct-PhD cases possible.
gates: When is the MBBS conferred?
Before or only after the internship? It decides SpaceMed, Commonwealth Shared, Maastricht and others that need the degree finished by a deadline.
Maastricht admission route
Bachelor's route (GRE needed) or bachelor's + master's route (no GRE)? Does his average convert to at least 7.5/10? Ask masteradmission-fhml@maastrichtuniversity.nl.
Swedish Institute's 3,000 hours
Paid or freelance work separate from the internship, before Feb 2027. The SI FAQ says internships don't count.
Hopkins work-experience line
The one-year line appears on the ScM page, not the PhD page. Ask BSPH.EpiAcademic@jh.edu whether the internship counts.
MBBS → direct PhD in Australia and NZ
No university says an MBBS alone qualifies. It's case by case (publications, research), with an MPhil as fallback.
WES timing
Starting in early November lands mid-December — too late for a verified 1 Dec file. Ask Hopkins and Emory if WES can follow.
Hopkins work-experience line (corrected)

The programme page lists one year of full-time related work as required, the Epi FAQ says only 'strongly recommended'; the old gate said it was on the ScM page only. Does an internship year count? Ask BSPH.EpiAcademic@jh.edu before paying $155.
Does an MBBS count as the Yale bachelor's equivalent?
Yale does not rule on MBBS and requires no master's; email phdms.publichealth@yale.edu. The PhD English rule is also Speaking-only, so ask which overall score they expect.
Does an MBBS with the internship in progress meet the MRC degree rule?
The Manchester page says First or Upper Second or international equivalent, held or about to be obtained, but does not mention MBBS. Ask fbmh.doctoralacademy.admissions@manchester.ac.uk.
Emory and WES

Laney and the programme do not require a credential evaluation, but the general Rollins how-to-apply page says international applicants must use WES. Ask Epidemiology admissions so you do not skip a required document.
Can WES follow the Hopkins submission?
Hopkins allows supporting documents within two weeks after 1 Dec, but its English waiver and completeness depend on the evaluation. Confirm what happens if WES lands after 15 Dec.
Does Pittsburgh accept an MBBS and waive the fee?
The programme expects a degree in a biological or physical science, maths, computer science or engineering, and a waiver was not found on the pages read. Ask the IBGP office.

extraLog.text: Master file: independent check of 34 entries against official pages — Eiffel age gate added (29 for master's), Columbia 1 Dec preferred deadline added, Maastricht scholarship close (1 Feb 2027) added, Monash Round 1 resolved to 28 Feb 2027, Commonwealth 2:1 rule added, Emory PhD deadline found (1 Dec).

Master file: live-browser re-check — UQ round confirmed closed 19 Oct, Massey closed 1 Oct, SpaceMed €5,000/yr self-funded fee confirmed, Swedish Institute internship rule confirmed. 22 spot-checks: 15 confirmed, 7 partial, 0 wrong.

New application packs added: USA 1 December (Hopkins, Emory, Pittsburgh, Yale, optional Hopkins GDEC and Columbia MPH) and MRC North West PhD (27 Nov); new guides: SOPHAS fees/waiver/costs, a twelve-school MPH shortlist, and third-party guidance with the Sakib talk.

Verified against official pages and corrected: Hopkins SOP has a two-page limit; Hopkins work experience is required on the programme page but only 'strongly recommended' in the FAQ; TOEFL iBT after 21 Jan 2026 uses the new scale (Hopkins 5.0); WES ICAP costs $239; SOPHAS will not review until documents arrive; Emory stipend $43,260 (Rollins page stale at $42,000) and WES for Emory is ask-first.

MRC corrections: statement has no limit (2-4 pages recommended), CV required, English test only at offer, stipend GBP 21,805 is the UKRI minimum (not on the Manchester page), fee not found. Yale PhD English gives Speaking minimums only (100/7.0 is the MS rule); GRE only for Biostatistics and HPM. UIC supplemental fee is $80; Columbia has a 1 Mar late date.
Lead resolved: the unnamed Netherlands 'up to EUR 22,000' award is the University of Twente Scholarship (EUR 3,000-22,000, closes 1 Apr 2027 16:00 CET), a partial award, not full funding.

Closed or corrected: Deakin RTP international round closed 23 Aug 2026 (25 Oct was the domestic round); McCall MacBain 2027 cohort closed 19 Aug 2026; Doha Tamim master's has no 10 h/week work rule (doctoral only); KFUPM SAR stipend figures are not official.
